objectives.statement: Recognize subordinate clauses introduced by at, fordi, and hvis.
Place ikke and common sentence adverbs before the finite verb inside subordinate clauses.
Build correct subordinate clauses with subjunction, subject, sentence adverb, and finite verb order.

notes: Must force subjunction-subject-sentence adverb-finite verb order; no V2 inside subordinate clauses. Cover at/fordi/hvis clauses. Defer relative clauses (som) to B1 relative_clauses and embedded wh-questions to B1 embedded_questions.
